**Finding: missing (INSURANCE)** — no insurance clause exists anywhere in the Agreement.

- Full-text search for "insurance" returned zero hits; General Matters (20(a)–(i)) covers time, notices, waiver, assignment, independent contractor, force majeure, severability, governing law and headings only, with no coverage or certificate obligation.
- Garman is not a pure license vendor: it installs the Software on our AS/400s at Authorized Locations (§4(a)), performs future installations and converts Sparkling's data (§4(b)), and provides ongoing maintenance and support — i.e. a vendor that touches our premises and our data, which is the rule's walk-away scenario when uninsured.
- Redline validated (ok:true): new Section 20(j) inserted after p0147 with the playbook's preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, workers' comp as required by law, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed) plus certificates on request; the comment flags the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback as a negotiating position.
